rows.Kwic: 榑桑不遠。莫向外馳求。當處發生。隨處自現。乾坤大地。皎皎明白。

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Fenyang Wude (汾陽無德禪師語錄): in his discourse, Fenyang Shanzhao contrasts outward seeking with arising right there and appearing wherever one goes.
